intro: The printer goes quiet. The Master Zine is finally complete.
Thirty days of work... all resting inside this one leather folder.
Time to take this straight to Mr. Reyes before the morning bell rings.
outro: A giant tarpaulin hangs from the campus balcony: 'CONGRATULATIONS THE PARAGON — 1st PLACE NSPC BEST LAYOUT & DESIGN!'
Finally... my official clearance is signed.
The publication lives, and the truth was heard.
Not bad for a rookie who didn't even know what a 'Serif' was last month.
Welcome to the team for real, Editor-in-Chief.
